verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Joshua, saying:
verses.2: And he said to the children of Israel, “Give yourselves these cities that I have given you by Moses’ hand.”
verses.3: Lanus Shama wanted to kill someone without any knowledge or understanding of the consequences. It was a foolish act from him, and it became a source of suffering for you.
verses.4: And he went to one of these towns. He stood at the gate of the town, and he spoke to the elders of that town. They gathered around him, gave him a place to sit with them, and allowed him to stay there.
verses.5: And since the murderer continued to shed blood after that, and did not stop the killing with his hands, it is because he did not know how to kill his own brother. He also did not want to be punished for his actions.
verses.6: And he shall dwell in that city until he stands before the council for judgment, until the death of the high priest who would be there at that time. Then the Redeemer will return and come to his city and to his home—to the city from which he was taken away.
verses.7: And they sanctified the Kedesh in Mount Neftali, and Shechem in Mount Efrém. And Kiryat Arba was also sanctified in Mount Yehudah.
verses.8: And from the east, to the land of Yericho, they gave Bezer on the shore, at the mouth of the river. They also gave Rammoth in Gilad, from the place called Gad. And they gave Golan in Bashan, from the place called Menashe.
verses.9: These were the cities of the assembly for all the children of Israel. The foreigners living among them died in their own homes, each one died in ignorance. They did not die at the hands of the judge, until they stood before the assembly.
